npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -80

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "---"; git status --short; echo "---"; node -e 'for (const p of ["@gravity-ui/markdown-editor","@gravity-ui/components","@gravity-ui/uikit","@gravity-ui/icons"]) { try { console.log(p, require("./node_modules/"+p+"/package.json").version) } catch(e) { console.log(p, "MISSING") } }'
npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | grep -B1 -A0 'uikit' | tail -60

npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 version peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const a=JSON.parse(s);for(const e of a){const u=e.peerDependencies?.["@gravity-ui/uikit"];if(u)console.log(e.version,u)}})' | tail -25

npm install @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 @gravity-ui/markdown-editor 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown env' | tail -40; echo "---"; node -e 'for (const p of ["@gravity-ui/markdown-editor","@gravity-ui/components","@gravity-ui/uikit","@gravity-ui/icons","@diplodoc/transform","markdown-it","katex","lowlight","highlight.js","react","react-dom"]) { try { console.log(p, require("./node_modules/"+p+"/package.json").version) } catch(e) { console.log(p, "MISSING") } }'; git diff --stat

cat build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ---; ls build/docs/guides

cat build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; echo ----; ls build/esm/view | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "MarkdownEditorView\b" build/esm/view/*.d.ts build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo ----; ls build/esm/styles; grep -rln "styles.css\|import '.*\.css'" build/esm --include=*.js | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm && grep -n "initial\|stickyToolbar\|autofocus\|mode\|placeholder\|height\|export type MarkdownEditorOptions\|export interface MarkdownEditorOptions" bundle/types.d.ts bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls bundle | head -50

cat bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 1,60p bundle/types.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 160,200p bundle/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "MarkdownEditorInitialOptions" -A12 bundle/types.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Flex Text Button 2>&1 | head -40; echo ----; grep -n "direction\|gap" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "variant" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "view?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3
